name: Overwhelming Evil (Prayer)
body:
The gods of evil cripple their enemies.

Prerequisites: Worshiping a deity with the Evil Domain, evil alignment

Benefit: Any enemy within 30 ft with damage reduction against all but evil see their damage reduction reduced by (1/2 your character level).

This effect lasts for 1 round per day.
